Subject: Request: third-party processing snapshot for procurement audit window

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement team at Avantis is kicking off a short evidence collection for our Q4 vendor review and we need a narrow snapshot of third-party processors that Redwood uses for the services tied to our contract (logging, observability, telemetry, CDN, KMS). The audit window is next Monday (2026-09-27) so timeline is tight.

Could you provide the following by EOD Thursday (2026-09-23):
- A single CSV listing all subprocessors used in the last 12 months for prod traffic, with columns: vendor name, primary function, countries where data is processed, data types (tokens, logs, telemetry), and whether they are covered by your DPA/DSS/KMS controls.
- A copy of the signed DPA or an index to the clause (if we already have it).
- Any attestations for onshore routing or temporary transit exceptions (if applicable).

Specific ask: we will need evidence that StreamCache (our caching partner) does not persist user message contents beyond short TTL — if you can flag this row and include a short note that ties to your evidence artifact that would be helpful.

I can add the audit mailbox (audit@avantis.com) once you confirm what you'll share. If you prefer, Kimberly can coordinate offline on format.

Regards,
Helen Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Avantis Financial
helen.park@avantis.com

Hi Helen,

Thanks — we can do that. High-level plan and timing:
- We will export a processor roster CSV that matches the columns you requested and flag StreamCache with an evidence reference.
- Deliverables: processor_roster_v3.csv + pointer to the signed DPA (dpa_signed_redwood_avantis.pdf).
- Delivery ETA: initial export by 2026-09-23 18:00 ET. If you need earlier, let me know and we'll prioritize.

A few clarifying Qs (so we scope correctly):
1) When you say "prod traffic used in the last 12 months" — do you want only processors that touched Avantis tenant data specifically, or all processors used in the production fleet that could touch customer request payloads?
2) For "countries where data is processed" — do you want all potential processing locations (including transit hop locations) or only persistent storage/residency locations?

Kimberly — can you pull the roster export and confirm whether the StreamCache TTL note + storage policy is present in our evidence bundle? Marcus — if you can confirm whether any StreamCache traffic for Avantis was routed via EU regions in the last 12 months, that would help answer the transit question.

I'll attach the roster and the DPA reference in the follow-up.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Accounts — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

Grace — appreciate the quick turnaround. Adding audit@avantis.com for visibility.

A couple of follow-ups from the audit team (short list):
- They want explicit confirmation for any processor that might persist request payloads (messages/inputs). StreamCache is the primary focus — if you can supply a single-sentence attestation and a pointer to the technical note or config that enforces the short TTL that would be ideal.
- Also, please indicate whether any telemetry/observability exports for Avantis cross from US to EU or vice versa (we don't need detailed logs, just an export map: yes/no + which vendors).

If you can mark the CSV row with the evidence id (e.g. EV-RED-2026-239) that will let our team pull the artifact from your portal.

Thanks,
Helen
